The best way to communicate on an MSC cruise is through the MSC for Me App, +1-866 829-1280(US) which features a free internal chat function requiring only connection to the ship's Wi-Fi network. Communicating on a MSC cruise is easiest using the free MSC Cruises app, +1-866 829-1280(US) which works on the ship's internal network without requiring an expensive internet package. Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) texting is possible on MSC cruises using Wi-Fi or onboard messaging features. You can message through apps +1-866-829-1280(US) like iMessage or WhatsApp with an internet package, or use the ship's internal app for basic communication.
